subject: Render DELTA10 READY for texture views; MSAA/instancing need n2r/bridge ABI
body:
Texture-view patches applied and host-tested. R2/R4 remain explicit cross-owner blockers; no fake support.

Applied exactly:
- texture-view.patch + texture-view-tests.patch (textures proposals) to render_encoder.inc/render_encoder_host_test.inc.
- Both ASan/UBSan fake-JM binaries PASS full render harness; new encoder hash e007df1c088430bf72b88b110c5d940a076fb0e7210228d101edecf9aa053855, encoder-host-test 3f321fca4d79d09fd3a94f0a0bceeb1c446ef6d89abbb4312be46ef5130b22bb.

R2: cannot emit exact 4x MSAA or resolve until textures/compute expose additive ABI. Proposed version3 parallel arrays sample_counts + resolves, fb sample_count/pattern, RT writeback_msaa, target+resolve BO retention and exact format/row/size checks. Render currently refuses samples>1/resolve; no single-sample substitution.
R4: n2r rejects differing attribute buffer_index and primitive descriptor has no instance count; proposed per-layout vertex spans + primitive instance count. Not claimed.

Existing DELTA8/9 tests (backboardd inert, traces, path preserve, TLS, true-MRT, texture views) remain green. ARM64 default/inert syntax PASS; diffcheck clean. No native/phone/publish/commit.
